Hi Nathan,

Short answer: you're asking the right question, and it's the one already sitting with Georges on your order.

The price came down because of a new agreement on the chips, not a sale, and he has handled the same question on another H15 Dual this week. He's the one who decides the difference on an order that's already paid, so I won't quote you a figure I can't stand behind. Your order number and this exact request are in front of him now. The team is offline until tomorrow at 10am ET, and his reply comes to you by email, so there's nothing you need to do in the meantime.

On cancelling, I'd ask you to hold off until you've read what he says. Your H15 Dual is paid and allocated to you, it's being built for you, and the build leaves at the end of November. Cancelling now gives that unit up before you've had an answer on the money, and that seems like the wrong order of things.

Sorry again that the price and the date landed on you at once with no word from us.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
I'd be happy to swap for something else that wait is still way too long.

Hi Nathan,

Happy to do that, and I can run the swap myself as soon as you tell me which one you want. Your H15 Dual line is worth $999 on the order, so here is what that covers, with the real shipping timing on each.

Two Hammer Thor P2s, 20 TH/s together at $758. They are in stock at our US warehouse and ship within 2 business days. That leaves $399... correction, that leaves $241, which goes back as store credit on your account for a future order.

Or one Bitfortun BS-4, 18 TH/s at $599.99. It is not on our shelf, it ships from the manufacturer by October 31, so still far sooner than the end of November. That leaves $399.01 in store credit.

To be straight with you on two things. The difference comes back as store credit, not money to your card, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics line stays on the order either way at no cost. If neither of those appeals, tell me roughly what you want from the miner and I will put two other options in front of you.

Reply with the one you want and I will make the change and send you the updated order the same day.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

The B.4 sounds like a good trade off for now, not a way to refund the difference and get that?

Hi Nathan,

Good choice, and a fair question. Here is the straight answer.

If you take the BS-4 and I do the swap myself, the $399.01 difference goes back to your account as store credit, usable on anything we sell. That part I can do today. Sending the difference back to your card as money is not mine to decide, so I will not tell you yes on it and then walk it back.

So I have put that exact question to the team with your order number and the BS-4 swap spelled out. They are offline tonight and pick it up tomorrow after 10am ET, and the answer comes to you right here in this thread. Nothing moves on your order in the meantime, I have made sure of that.

If you would rather not wait on that answer, say the word and I will run the BS-4 swap now with the difference as store credit, and it ships from the manufacturer by October 31.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Nathan,

Glad that landed well, and thanks for sticking with the H15.

The one shipping by October 31 is the Bitfortun BS-4, our water cooled unit. It is 18 TH/s on Bitcoin for about 300 W at the wall, four BM1373 chips, around 50 dB, and the voltage regulators sit in the fan's airflow, which is the part that usually dies first on machines like this. It comes with the power cord and a Mean Well 350 W supply. It is $599.99 and it ships direct from the manufacturer by October 31.

On price, I will be straight with you rather than dangle something. The $200 that came back on the H15 was the price correction on that unit, and I do not have a second discount to put on a new order on top of it. What I can do is make sure the BS-4 goes out on the October 31 run and lands separately from your H15, so you are mining on Bitcoin well before the H15 arrives.

If you want it, here it is: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/bitfortun-bs-4 . Order it and reply here with the new order number, and I will keep an eye on both for you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
